summary: Round-97 full backend + frontend E2E for Vesper v1.5.0 Anime hub and single-popup launch. Backend 8/8 pass (anime hub w/ 16 rails incl. all required ids, cached<10s on 2nd call, by-genres -8 for both tv & movie incl. Spirited Away, custom-row anime synthetic). Frontend verified on https://rebrand-app-5.preview.emergentagent.com: /anime renders with [data-testid=anime-page], eyebrow 'Anime · Movies & Series', 16 shelves (incl. trending-series, popular-movies, airing-now, top-series, top-movies, ghibli, action, comedy, kids, classics), initial focus on first poster tile, hero follows focus, <iframe>/<video> appears within 4s, ArrowDown moves between shelves, Escape returns to /. top-nav-anime placed between top-nav-boxsets and top-nav-library and highlights on /anime. Movies chips show 'anime' at position 5 after Hallmark; TV chips show 'Anime' as the FIRST chip after All (confirmed via screenshot); clicking the Movies anime chip renders 500 grid-anime-* tiles. Home has [data-testid=custom-row-shelf-anime]; Settings → Home screen lists home-row-anime at position 05 right after home-row-studios (04). Add-a-category panel chips are hallmark, christmas, ANIME (3rd), action, adventure, ...  — matches spec. What's New modal appears on /profiles, headline 'Anime, Box Sets, Studios & a Home screen that’s yours', Enter dismisses, writes onnowtv-whatsnew-seen-v1=1.5.0 AND vesper-onboarding-seen-v1 AND sessionStorage vesper-whatsnew-shown=1; after selecting profile NO onboarding/tour modal and NO feature-nudge appeared within 10s. Overlay count never > 1. Batman box-set regression still works.

tv_chips.note: DOM-query from Playwright sometimes returned empty due to tab-grid lazy mount, but screenshot and user-visible state show chips rendered correctly.

whats_new_single_popup.headline: Anime, Box Sets, Studios & a Home screen that’s yours
whats_new_single_popup.spec_said_13_items_actual_12: Minor copy mismatch: spec expected 13 cards (incl. Anime); UI renders 12. All Anime copy is present as its own card. Non-blocking.

action_items: (Optional) Whats-new modal shows 12 cards but the review spec requested 13; verify whether a planned 13th card was dropped or whether the spec count is stale.
critical_code_review_comments: Pre-existing noise (not a regression): console warnings '[vesperCloudSync] push failed TypeError: Failed to fetch' and torrentio/plexio CORS errors still spam the console in preview. Consider silencing when the cloud sync endpoint is unreachable or when running inside preview pod.
Minor: Whats-new modal item count (12) is off-by-one vs. iteration-97 spec expectation of 13; recheck /app/frontend/src/components/WhatsNewModal.jsx items array if the 13th card was intentional.
Anime hub cold-start takes ~5-6s in current preview (well under the 12s spec budget); subsequent requests return cached:true in <1s — good.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on 8/8 feature groups; one minor copy mismatch (12 vs 13 whats-new items) flagged as non-blocking

seed_data_creation: Visited /?e2e=1 to set sessionStorage vesper-e2e=1; logged in testuser/testpass123; seeded localStorage onnowtv-profiles-v1[:testuser]+onnowtv-active-profile-v1[:testuser]=p-test-1, vesper-onboarding-seen-v1=now, onnowtv-whatsnew-seen-v1=9.9.9; cleared onnowtv-home-rows-v1* keys. For the single-popup test, removed both onnowtv-whatsnew-seen-v1 and vesper-onboarding-seen-v1 before visiting /profiles.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Anime hub rail testids on /anime are 'shelf-anime-<rail-id>' (plus mirror 'shelf-row-anime-<rail-id>') — total 16 rails. Posters inside use 'poster-anime-<rail-id>-<type>-<tmdbId>' naming. Backend returns {rails:[...]} with keys id/title/eyebrow/data; each item has type in {movie,tv,series} — note 'series' is also valid (contract observed in actual response), not strictly 'tv'. by-genres endpoint returns {cached, data:[...]} (not {items}). Movies chip order is All, In Cinema, Christmas, Hallmark, Anime, ... — Anime is 5th (position 4). TV chips start with All, Anime, Drama, Comedy, ... — Anime is first after All. Whats-new modal currently renders 12 cards (spec expected 13); flagged non-blocking. Single-popup gating (sessionStorage vesper-whatsnew-shown + vesper-onboarding-seen-v1 on dismiss) works correctly — no concurrent overlays observed.
rca of the issue: No defects discovered. Only observation worth noting: WhatsNewModal item count (12) is one less than iteration-97 review spec expected (13 incl. Anime); the Anime card IS present and prominently shown, so this appears to be either a spec miscount or an intentional edit.
